status: Implementation source and single-owner paper example reviewed against diagram contract; native Medium rendering pending

captions.order-path: A paper workflow boundary: user-owned limits and a fresh supplied snapshot determine admission. Confidence stays metadata. The single-owner caller updates the book after a simulated fill; this diagram does not establish live or concurrent execution safety.
captions.visibility-window: An audit of declared knowledge and recorded scoring data. Reusing a factor in a different legitimate walk-forward fold is allowed; repeating the same declared trial is flagged. Declarations are not trusted timestamp or complete-knowledge evidence.

alt_text.order-path: Agent proposal, user limits and cash/holdings/pending snapshot feed a decision. Refusal returns reasons; admission goes to the single-owner paper executor, whose simulated fill updates the next snapshot.
alt_text.visibility-window: Training files and declared visibility feed hash/date checks. Recorded score dates are checked against a later scoring window. Trial fingerprints distinguish valid different folds from repeated identical declarations.

visual_review: PNG exports inspected for readable unclipped labels; consistent with reviewed tool scopes. Native article caption/alt/readback pending.
